keyFindings.description: No row of TestAJJThatCreatesARepositoryIsRefusedInsideOne holds the case this round made load-bearing: a `.jj` that is a symlink to a directory. jj opens that repository (measured by the deep review). Production refuses it through os.Stat, but a change to os.Lstat + IsDir would pass every row while jj went on to write the repository. The tester recorded the same gap. Add a row with the parent's .jj symlinked to a .jj directory, and expect a refusal that names it.

The -R invariant (Dir is the -R target) is kept by hand at three sites that rebuild runCheckedOnClone: bookmark.go:199-203, and config.go:836-840 and :858 in removeRepositoryIdentity. The invariant's list is also written twice, at config.go:540-544 and docs/testing.md:66-67. Route the three sites through runCheckedOnClone. State the invariant once, on onClone/runCheckedOnClone, where Dir is chosen, and have docs/testing.md point to it.

The refusal (:434) and its echoes (:225, :416, enclosingrepository_test.go:86 and :299-300, docs/testing.md:65 and :79-80) say the run writes the enclosing repository in every case. jj 0.45.1 writes config-id only when that repository still holds a legacy .jj/repo/config.toml. I measured a fresh 0.45.1 repository: it gained nothing. Make the claim conditional.

Two comments are stale. ':396-400' says 'Run's three refusals', but Run has more refusals, and one of the three it names is a strip that refuses nothing. ':533-534' says 'guardWorkspace is unchanged for every command', which describes the diff, not the code.

The comment at :57-62 calls the symlink row 'the live operator case, a legion.yaml kept inside a checkout with state_dir resolved against it'. A relative state_dir resolves lexically, with no symlink, so that case is the first row.
